14_powermamba_baseline_pytorch.py.paper_reference: Menati et al. (2024) - PowerMamba: Lightweight State Space Model for Energy Forecasting

deviations: CRITICAL DEVIATION: Fails to implement canonical PowerMamba (Menati et al., 2024): lacks dual-path iMamba (transposed variate scan), concatenated [T; S] fixed embedding, and composite fusion head; implemented as shortcut (SeriesDecomp + 1D SSM + Linear + MLP head).
